vb_textbox.text: The advice I was given was to look for certain colour combinations which yielded the best payouts, and switch them around when rewards dropped.  However, I found that the colour of the gnome didn't matter, and the shape of the hat was more important.  In my case, the pointer hat offered higher rewards than the more rounded hat.  I suspect the criteria for the "best" gnome switches up between batches of the experiment.  Don't allow yourself to be swayed by our findings too much, because I think they change - just bear in mind that while colour counts, so does the shape of the hat.
